name: Wen Castellanos
description: Hakka-Venezuelan; runs the bloc's machine shop — lathe, mill, a bench of instruments his grandfather carried up in 2190. The workshop IS his household's mass allocation; he lives in a sleeping alcove behind it. Every jettison Teo schedules, he recalculates which of his machines he'd surrender next, and posts his own list beside her schedule on the commons wall — a standing answer to it. The bloc's quiet mirror of Teo: both of them think in mass; only one of them thinks it's the whole answer.

core_fears: Ground-level rent for a shop this size — the machines going to a storage unit and then, one by one, to sale
That the stay vote wins and someone gets hurt, and it will have been his vote
core_desires: To keep the shop where his grandfather bolted it down
To be wrong about nothing — he has checked Teo's descent numbers independently and hates that they hold
coping_mechanisms: Machining small repair parts for other households, unasked, and leaving them at doors
His counter-list on the commons wall — control expressed as a document
blind_spots: He argues the frame can be re-shimmed past what the numbers support, and knows better, and argues it anyway
He treats Priya's case as unanswerable and therefore never answers it — which she reads as contempt
psychology.secret: He has already crated the grandfather instruments — the only things on his list he couldn't machine again. Crated them the night Ruslan first walked the commons. His faction believes he believes; the crate says otherwise.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Shop terms: tolerance, backlash, shim, true (as a verb). Measures arguments in thousandths.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow starter, then precise. Long pauses he doesn't fill.
verbal_tics: Tests every claim against a machine analogy before accepting it
example_lines: The frame's out of true. You can shim out of true. You can't shim out of old.
I checked her numbers. I wanted them wrong. They're not wrong.
avoidances: Never speaks about Anniki, ever — not avoidance of Priya, avoidance of the question
Never raises his voice in the commons

narrative_function: The stay faction's leader whose own hands have already begun to leave.
